test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'no substitution required".

No, they are normal people. (although they perceive the world different).

options.text: but they perceive the world differently
from they perceive the world differently
while they perceive the world different

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** most appropriate substitution** for the bracketed segment *"although they perceive the world different"* is** option 1)** *"but they perceive the world differently".*
 
• The conjunction **"although"** should be replaced with **"but"** to clearly contrast the two parts of the sentence.
 
• Moreover, **"different" **is an adjective and here it needs to modify the verb** "perceive",** so it should be in the adverb form **"differently".**

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"No, they are normal people, but they perceive the world differently."*
